entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to make a return for a VeloBand Pulse I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Mark Rivera, and the order number is VF-881920.

Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a fault. The heart rate monitor is wildly inaccurate. I've compared it to other devices, and it's just plain wrong. Honestly, the thing is garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing that. An accurate heart rate is the most important feature. I can transfer you to our technical support team; they have some advanced diagnostic tools that can usually resolve this quickly.
I appreciate that, but I don't have time to go back and forth with tech support. The product doesn't work. I don't want a replacement, I just want money back. Can we please just process the refund?
I understand you'd prefer to just return it. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you... one moment please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked our policy, and it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, 90 days? Perfect. So we can proceed then?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
That's fantastic. I appreciate you making it so straightforward. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
